goal: Allow importing public descriptors into wallets without re-supplying private keys the wallet already holds
Prevents users from having to expose sensitive private key material over RPC during descriptor imports
agreement: Broad concept support with no open objections
Support because it avoids manual handling and exposure of private keys (rkrux)
Has tested a version of this approach and plans to adopt this PR (Sjors)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fulfills a user request to import descriptors without re-supplying private keys
Removes the need to expose sensitive private keys over RPC when the wallet already has them
